notes: Very clean course: the overwhelming majority (~86) are non-learner-facing sub-glosses where a Spanish function word (que, no, en, de, a, me, te, lo) is sliced inside larger LEGOs and glossed contextually, plus ~29 legitimate English inflection/infinitive/contraction variants of the same lemma. The only real signal is a systematic statement-vs-question pattern: identical declarative Spanish prompts (hablas, querías ... ) are drilled as both a statement and a do-support question — the SSi statement→question convergence — which collapses to one prompt string and should carry an interrogative cue (the bare '¿...?' marking) to restore 1:1 mapping; plus a handful of synonym pairs (well/okay, no thanks variants, a lot of/many) to consolidate. No high-severity (constant-hit) overloads and no wrong-data glosses.
